$comment: Generated from lib/storelib-theme/controls/registry.ts. Do not edit by hand.

richtext.label: Rich text
richtext.description: Formatted text. Stored as sanitised HTML; output with the `raw` filter.

checkbox.label: Checkbox
checkbox.description: On or off, drawn as a checkbox. Prefer `toggle` for a single switch.

select.label: Select
select.description: One of a list, drawn as a dropdown.

radio.label: Radio
radio.description: One of a short list, every option visible.

color.label: Colour
color.description: A hex colour. The default may name a scheme colour, "scheme.accent", which the setting follows until somebody picks one.

color_scheme.label: Colour scheme
color_scheme.description: One of the theme's named colour schemes, by key: the built-in white, light, dark, black and highlight (Light, Soft, Dark, Brand and Accent in the editor) or one the creator added. The editor offers every scheme the theme has; see docs/theme/16-design-tokens.md.

color_background.label: Background
color_background.description: A colour or a CSS gradient for something to sit on. Only colours, gradient functions, angles and stops: a value that could leave the declaration it is written in is refused.

font_picker.label: Font
font_picker.description: A font family from the theme's font list.

inline_richtext.label: Inline rich text
inline_richtext.description: One line of formatted text: bold, italic, underline and links, nothing that starts a new block. Stored as cleaned HTML; output with the `raw` filter.

html.label: HTML
html.description: Markup a creator pastes, such as an embed from another service. Cleaned on save against the custom HTML allow list: no script, no forms, frames only from known players. Output with the `raw` filter.

datetime.label: Date and time
datetime.description: A date, or a date and a time, written as 2026-03-14 or 2026-03-14T23:00 with an optional zone such as +02:00. Read as written, never shifted to the server's time zone. Format it with the `date` filter.

focal_point.label: Focal point
focal_point.description: Where the important part of a picture is, as `object-position` reads it: "30% 70%". Name the picture setting it belongs to with `image`, and the editor lets the creator tap the spot on that picture.

image_picker.label: Image
image_picker.description: One image from the media library. Stored as an asset reference, rendered as a URL.

video_picker.label: Video
video_picker.description: A video file from the media library, or a hosted video URL.

file_picker.label: File
file_picker.description: Any file from the media library.

icon_picker.label: Icon
icon_picker.description: One icon from Storelib's icon library, by name.

url.label: Link
url.description: Where something links to: a page of the site, a product, or any address.

video_url.label: Video link
video_url.description: A YouTube or Vimeo link, in any shape people paste: a watch page, a short link, a Shorts link or a player address. Anything else is refused. Show it with `src="{{ settings.video | embed }}"` and the `embed` capability. `accept` narrows it to one host.

page_picker.label: Page
page_picker.description: One of the site's pages, by key.

product_picker.label: Product
product_picker.description: One of the creator's products. Printed on its own it is the product's address, so `href="{{ settings.product | url }}"` works as it always has; it also carries the product's live `title`, `price`, `compare_price`, `image`, `url` and `id`, read as `settings.product.title`, whenever the page knows that product.

product_list.label: Product list
product_list.description: Several of the creator's products, chosen and ordered by the creator, stored by id. The template receives them block-shaped, like `products`, with the live title, price and picture: `{% for block in settings.featured %}`. `limit` caps how many, 12 unless given, never more than 24.

link_list.label: Menu
link_list.description: One of the site's menus, by handle. The template receives `{ handle, title, links }`, each link `{ title, url, links }` with every address already made safe. `main-menu` is the header's own links unless the creator made a menu of that name.

community_picker.label: Community
community_picker.description: One of the creator's own communities, stored by id. Printed on its own it is the community page's address, so `href="{{ settings.community | url }}"` works; it also carries the community's live `name`, `tagline`, `image` (the cover), `logo`, `members`, `members_label`, `posts`, `events` (upcoming), `price` and `join_label`, read as `settings.community.name`. Only a community that is the creator's own, published and public, while communities are on: any other id is empty, so `{% if settings.community.name %}` draws nothing for it.

header.label: Header
header.description: A heading in the sidebar. Holds no value.

paragraph.label: Paragraph
paragraph.description: A line of help text in the sidebar. Holds no value.

example.content: Shown above the fold on every page.

divider.label: Divider
divider.description: A rule between groups of settings. Holds no value.

unsupported.collection: Storelib has no collections. Use product_list for chosen products, or the section's `products` for the whole shop.
unsupported.collection_list: Storelib has no collections. Use product_list for chosen products.
unsupported.blog: A Storelib site has no blog of its own yet.
unsupported.article: A Storelib site has no blog of its own yet.
unsupported.metaobject: Storelib has no metaobjects. Use blocks for repeated content.
unsupported.metaobject_list: Storelib has no metaobjects. Use blocks for repeated content.
unsupported.liquid: A section's template is its code. Write the markup in <template>, or make a section of your own in the code editor.
unsupported.color_scheme_group: Colour schemes are the theme's, edited in Theme settings › Colors. A section picks one with color_scheme.
